### `runAdaptiveDamBreakMacroComparison({ steps = 8, dtSeconds = 1 / 120, restDensityKgM3 = 1000, } = {})`

Early dam-break macro oracle. Internal SPH forces may differ by resolution, but mass, volume, center-of-mass motion, and net momentum must remain close.
